problem:
The vector-valued function $f(\theta ,ϕ),$ given by 

$$
f(\theta ,ϕ)=⟨\operatorname{cosh}⁡ϕ\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta ,\,\text{_____},\,2\operatorname{sinh}⁡ϕ⟩
$$

parametrizes the hyperboloid of one sheet defined in Cartesian coordinates as 

$$
{x}^{2}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{16}-\frac{{z}^{2}}{4}=1.
$$

By first considering the transformations

$$
x=X,\,y=4Y,\,z=2Z
$$

and writing the resulting system in cylindrical polar coordinates, determine the second component of $f.$

*Hint: You may use the fact that the hyperbola ${r}^{2}-{Z}^{2}={k}^{2}$ can be parametrized as $⟨r,Z⟩=⟨k\operatorname{cosh}⁡ϕ,k\operatorname{sinh}⁡ϕ⟩$* for $ϕ\in R.$
